prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in Katy, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported concussion. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1280; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- A few old scratches may be older than this crash.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling in the left lane of a multi-lane roadway in Katy, Texas, when the sideswipe collision occurred. Driver 1 reported that Driver 2 changed lanes into the same space without adequate clearance, causing contact along the left side of Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 2 gave a statement consistent with this account and did not dispute that a lane change had taken place. Two independent witnesses at the scene described the sequence in the same way, and photographs taken on scene show damage along the right front of Driver 2's vehicle and the left side of Driver 1's vehicle, which is consistent with the reported impact. Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat of Driver 1's vehicle, and both the responding officers and the witnesses confirmed Passenger's presence at the time of the crash. Driver 1 reported a concussion with headache and dizziness, which is a plausible injury for a sideswipe of this kind. Several small scratches on the left rear panel appear weathered and may predate this collision; they were noted but not attributed to this event. Driver 1 is listed as a named driver on the policy in force at the time of the incident.
